sections.heading: Execution checklist
sections.body:
1. Set low=500 high=700 on your grid UI or bot
2. Configure 12 geometric levels; size ≈ $83.33 each
3. Enable pause when unrealized DD ≥ 6%
4. Start with 50% capital; scale after 24h of stable fills
